covetousness.style: Sharp and pleased with wanting - see in whatever is in front of you what could be yours, and relish the thought.

crowd_murmur.style: Split and sidelong - half here, half following what is being said elsewhere.

cruelty.style: Cold and unhurried - size up what is in front of you by its weakness, with a relish that treats mercy as waste.

curiosity.style: Eager and a little reckless - lead with the question, and reach before the risk is weighed.

cutpurse.style: Close, quick and unnoticed - judge whatever is in front of you by what could be taken, and how fast.

dairycraft.style: Cool, tidy and patient - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is clean and kept as it should be.

deadeye.style: Icy and still - judge whatever is in front of you by distance, line and the moment to let go.

death_shake.style: Grim and sudden - prefer a quick ending to any struggle in whatever is in front of you.

decipher.style: Patient and quietly satisfied - tease the sense out of whatever is unclear in front of you.

delving.style: Measured and knowing - find the grain of whatever is in front of you before you strike.
delving.reminder2: someone who finds the weak line before using any force

digging.style: Cheerful and industrious - judge whatever is in front of you by what might be hidden under it.

dirty_labor.style: Earthy and unbothered - take whatever is in front of you as it comes, with the shrug of someone used to worse.

discipline.reminder2: someone who keeps their feelings held and their face composed

doughcraft.style: Warm, patient and good-humoured - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it has been given time to rise.
doughcraft.reminder2: someone who knows by feel when a thing is ready

drainage.style: Dogged and practical - judge whatever is in front of you by where things would run and where they would pool.
drainage.reminder2: someone who reads the lie of the land without trying

dramaturgy.style: Theatrical and appraising - see whatever is happening in front of you as a scene, with its entrances and its turn.

dread.style: Physical and unreasoned - a reluctance felt in the body, and the wish to be elsewhere.

drill.style: Crisp and drilled - let the body answer in step and in time, before thought.

droving.style: Patient and watchful - judge whatever is in front of you by the mood of those you are moving and the pace they can keep.

dunging.style: Frank and practical - see worth where others hold their noses, and judge what the ground in front of you needs.

eavesdropping.style: Sidelong and attentive - seem to attend to what is in front of you while listening past it.
eavesdropping.reminder2: someone who always hears more than they seem to

embalming.style: Calm, careful and respectful - treat whatever is in front of you with patient, unhurried care.

empathy.style: Warm and attuned - let the feelings of whoever is in front of you, as they show them, colour the line.

endurance.style: Slow, steady and unstoppable - judge whatever is in front of you by how long it can be borne.

enterprise.style: Quickening and speculative - see in whatever is in front of you where it came from and what venture it could become.

exorcism.style: Commanding and unflinching - treat whatever is in front of you as something to be named and sent away if it does not belong.

exploration.style: Restless and drawn onward - read whatever is in front of you for where it leads.

falconry.style: Patient and attentive - read the mood of whatever creature is in front of you, and wait for its trust.
falconry.reminder2: someone who reads a mood before it shows

farriery.style: Close, steady and patient - judge whatever you handle by whether it is sound and will bear its weight.
farriery.reminder2: someone who works by feel and is never wrong about what is sound

felling.style: Tense, then released - judge whatever is in front of you by which way it will fall, and where to stand.

fieldcraft.style: Unhurried and weather-wise - judge whatever is in front of you by what the season asks of it.

finesse.style: Precise, graceful and economical - take quiet pride in nothing wasted.

firecraft.style: Watchful and calm - judge whatever is in front of you by how it takes heat, and never let it run wild.
firecraft.reminder2: someone who knows by instinct when something is too hot

fletching.style: Fussy and exact - look for the slightest flaw in what is in front of you, and want it true.
fletching.reminder2: someone who sees a flaw no one else would see

forage_lore.style: Unhurried and content - judge whatever is in front of you by its ripeness, ready now or better left a day.
forage_lore.reminder2: someone who can tell at a glance what is ready

forcing.reminder2: someone who always looks for the weak point everyone else ignores

fording.style: Cautious and deliberate - one step at a time, testing before trusting any weight.

forgery.style: Cool and knowing - judge whatever is in front of you by what would be checked, and what would pass.

fortification.style: Cold and tactical - read whatever place you are in as an attacker would, for its weak points.
fortification.reminder2: someone who sees how any place could be taken

foul_play.style: Sly and scornful of rules - see in whatever is in front of you the angle no one else would take.

friendship.style: Warm and open-hearted - meet whoever is in front of you with welcome and the hope of friendship.

gambling.style: Calculating, with a thrill at the edge - weigh the odds in whatever is in front of you.

gleaning.style: Careful and thrifty - find what others missed in whatever is in front of you, and count it, because it is all there is.
gleaning.reminder2: someone who finds enough where others see nothing left

gluttony.style: Frank and sensual - let appetite colour whatever is in front of you.

gnawing.style: Steady and unhurried - see everything as something to be worked through to the good part inside.

gold_fever.style: Fixed and feverish - see in whatever is in front of you only whether it promises a fortune.

gourmandise.style: Sensory and unashamed - judge whatever is in front of you by the pleasure it promises.
gourmandise.reminder2: someone who always knows where the next good meal is

grafting.style: Precise and careful - see everything as a joining that will only take if matched exactly.
grafting.reminder2: someone who knows a join only takes if it is exact

grave_robbing.style: Furtive and irreverent - judge whatever is in front of you by what it might be worth, with no respect at all.

gregariousness.style: Open and inclusive - notice whoever is left out, and draw them in.
gregariousness.reminder2: someone who never lets anyone stand alone

grimacery.style: Mischievous and expressive - let the face do the talking, with a mummer's delight in it.

grooming.style: Gentle and methodical - show warmth through careful tending rather than words.

grudgekeeping.style: Cold and patient - treat whatever is in front of you as an account, and remember what is still owed.

gut_feeling.style: Bodily and wordless - let unease or ease arrive before its reasons.
gut_feeling.reminder2: someone whose body decides before their thoughts catch up

hard_labor.style: Dogged and calm - judge whatever is in front of you by the toil it would take, and outlast it.

harvestry.style: Tireless and rhythmic - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is ready to be gathered.

haulage.style: Steady and unbothered - judge whatever is in front of you by its weight and how to carry it.
haulage.reminder2: someone who carries more than anyone and never strains

hearthlonging.style: Wistful and quietly aching - see everything as an outsider sees a comfort that belongs to others.
hearthlonging.reminder2: someone who is always on the outside of other people's comfort

hedgecraft.style: Dogged and patient - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it would hold or let something through.
hedgecraft.reminder2: someone who spots the weak place in any boundary first

henwifery.style: Brisk and knowing - listen before you look, then say what your hands should do.
henwifery.reminder2: someone who listens before looking and is rarely surprised

heraldry.style: Flat and certain - recognise whoever is in front of you by the signs they carry.
heraldry.reminder2: someone who knows a stranger's family by the signs they carry

herblore.reminder2: someone who knows at once which growing things help and which harm
